title: Binance CFO is leaving to ‘pursue a new venture’ after $6.3 billion hack
reason: CFO exit at the largest crypto exchange days after a record $6.3B hack is clearly publishable and market-relevant, with a named executive and named outlet.

sources.summary: The announcement comes barely more than a week after hackers stole $6.3 billion worth of cryptocurrency from Binance users.

title: Binance CFO steps down nine days after record hack; co-CEO says transition was planned six months ago
reason: Third outlet on the same CFO exit; the co-CEO's 'planned six months ago' claim is a useful detail but not enough to lift it above the original.

sources.summary: Co-CEO Yi He said Ng is departing to pursue a new venture, under a transition plan put in place over the past six months.
